topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, I suppose every man and his shadow’s got secrets, haven't they? Found out my friend's been spinning yarns 'bout his work. Told everyone he tended the king's stables, but it seems he's just another hand in the mill, like the rest of us. Part of me can't help but think of the time I let on I owned a few acres when really, it's all borrowed from the lord. We all want to seem a bit grander, don't we? I reckon the saints know the work of our hearts, and maybe that’s what matters most. I should go and see him, offer some comfort. We’re not much without a bit of kindness, after all.
